title: National workers rally and anti-revision action at Hibiya Open-Air Music Hall
threshold_50_evidence: Organizer page reports 2,050 joined the Nov 1 Hibiya gathering.

location.summary: Hibiya Open-Air Music Hall, Tokyo; distinct later route not counted.

demands.summary: Opposition to layoffs/pay cuts, anti-union repression, constitutional revision and Suga cabinet.

notes: Body supports actual Nov 1 public rally at a named venue, 2,050 participants and domestic labor/policy demands including opposition to Suga cabinet and constitutional revision. Later march attendance is not added. Single organizer source; reported count is not independent corroboration. Distinguish hall gathering from subsequent street march.
open_questions: Check independent local reporting for same-site estimate and whether event belongs to an established recurring episode.

title: Scholars and students protest at National Diet against appointment refusals

organizer: Scholars Against Security Law and National University Volunteers (reported)
threshold_50_evidence: Kinyobi reports about 800 gathered before the Diet on Nov 3.

start_date.summary: Article published Nov 27 reports the Nov 3 action.

location.summary: In front of National Diet, Tokyo.

demands.summary: Protest political intervention; reverse six appointment refusals.

notes: Kinyobi account supplies date, site, about 800, and demand to reverse the six appointment refusals. Distinct from the broader “total action” count in a separate account. No count is inferred from neighboring gatherings. Coding remains pending review.
open_questions: Seek independent source or original group record; check appointment campaign onset/ownership across Oct-Nov.
